description: Nonprime consumer lender offering personal loans, auto finance, credit cards, and insurance.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-10-30 (Friday, before the open), 41 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 1.88.
catalyst.why: 2026-10-30 report must show net charge-offs rising and EPS below 1.88 to confirm deterioration.

reasons: EPS is falling: latest quarter EPS 1.31 vs 1.45 a year ago, and net income dropped 32.7% quarter-over-quarter, showing credit costs are eating profit.
The company lends to nonprime borrowers, and subprime auto delinquencies hit 6.8%, worst in 32 years; rising losses will force higher provisions and lower earnings.
Analyst estimates are already being cut: 8 downward revisions vs 6 upward in last 30 days, yet stock trades at 8.6x forward earnings, not cheap for deteriorating credit.

quants.eps_revisions: tilted lower, with 6 up and 8 down over last 30 days
extra: Last quarter net income decreasing 33% quarter over quarter (6/30/2026)
Last quarter other operating items increasing 31% quarter over quarter (6/30/2026)

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-10-30 report, with the long leg expiring 2026-11-20, which gives the deterioration time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The conservative credit ratio is 7.9%, below the 10% floor, so the structure needs about two more short puts sold to clear it. That adds short gamma risk if the stock bounces into earnings, but the net debit is modest at $3,888.
